title: Chapter 49 She Is From My Ice Phoenix Clan
content:
Chapter 49 She Is From My Ice Phoenix Clan

"Xiaoxue, how did you come here?"

Yan Luo asked again at this time.

Hearing this question, Lu Xue sighed.

"Good question, I don't know."

"It seems that the White Bear Clan leader summoned me here, and said I have great luck."

Hearing this, Yan Luo was obviously a little surprised, but she didn't think much about it.

It seems to be a coincidence.

"Then is your father in this world?"

Lu Xue shook her head, "My father is still in the Hongmeng Universe, but I believe he will come to me soon."

When he said this, Lu Xue's eyes were full of determination.

Seeing this, Yan Luo nodded as well.

"Xiaoxue, follow me to go back to the Phoenix tribe. It's too dangerous outside. You are my sister's daughter. I need to take care of your safety."

Looking at Lu Xue, Yan Luo spoke.

Although she and Lu Xue's mother Yan Lingyun are half-sister relationships, it does not affect the family relationship between them. On the contrary, they have a good relationship.

She only regretted that she was single and weak back then and could not speak for Lu Xue's mother.

Now, fate has made her meet her sister's child, and she will never let her go.

Looking at Yan Luo's sincere expression, after hesitating for a moment, Lu Xue finally agreed.

After all, this is her aunt, so she probably won't sell her.

Yan Luo was very happy to see Lu Xue agreeing.

Then the two set out to the Feng Clan’s location, the Feng Domain.

"Xiaoxue, what kind of person is your father?"

On the way, Yan Luo asked curiously.

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked up and recalled for a moment, then said, "It's nothing special, it's just amazing, and very rich."

Hearing this answer, Yan Luo smiled, but felt a little disappointed.

Unexpectedly, my sister would eventually marry and have children with such an ordinary person.

What Lu Xue said was very powerful and rich. In her opinion, it was just that Lu Xue was still young and had a short-sighted experience and had never seen the world.

As for the magic sword, it looks really good. I think it must be something Lu Xue got by chance.

Shaking his head, Yan Luo took Lu Xue and continued to head towards the Fengyu.

......

"Huh? Yan Luo, why did you bring the individual woman back?"

After a while, Yan Luo and Lu Xue finally arrived at Fengdi.

Shortly after entering the Phoenix Realm, he encountered a fifth-level fire phoenix in the Earth Realm. His pupils stared at Lu Xue behind Yan Luo, with an extremely unkind look.

Seeing this, Yan Luo frowned slightly.

"What does it have to do with you? Get out of the way, I'm going to see my father."

Yan Luo said coldly.

The next moment, a sixth-level aura gushed out of his body, and the surrounding temperature also dropped rapidly under the pressure of the Bingfeng.

Suddenly, the fire phoenix's face changed slightly and he quickly gave in.

Seeing this, Yan Luo snorted coldly, then took Lu Xue to continue to go deeper.

In place, looking at Yan Luo who was moving away, the Huo Feng looked ugly.

"It's the human race again, haha, if the clan leader knows, I'll see how you finish it."

He sneered and left immediately.

"Where is my father?"

As soon as he returned to his residence, Yan Luo asked the guards.

"Miss, Lord Yan is in seclusion. Lord Yan has an order and he is not allowed to disturb him."

The guard said respectfully.

Hearing this answer, Yan Luo frowned slightly, but said nothing.

"Xiaoxue, I'll take you to your place to live first. Oh, forget it, you'd better live with me."

Yan Luo pulled Lu Xue and said with some concern.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded obediently.

This is not familiar with the place.

However, it may be because of the ice phoenix bloodline that Lu Xue is not very resentful of this place.

However, what they both didn't know was that the news that Lu Xue came to the Phoenix Clan soon spread throughout the Phoenix Clan.

"Do you know, there is another human race there?"

"I'll go, it's true. Didn't the clan leader give an order? Is there no alien race allowed in the clan?"

"Haha, let me tell you, this time, Yan Luo brought it back in person. He really is a woman who inherits her father's business."

Because of Yan Luo's mother's incident, Yan Luo's father, Yan Fengtian, was completely disgraced in the clan.

In the end, he was removed from his post in the clan because of this.

Soon, this incident reached the ears of the Fire Phoenix Clan leader.

Suddenly, the Fire Phoenix Clan Chief was furious and then led everyone to Yan Luo's residence.

......

"Yan Luo! If you bring the human race back to the tribe privately, what crime should you be punished!"

"Come on, take that human race away!"

The leader of the Huofeng tribe came to Yan Luo's residence and shouted angrily.

This action immediately scared Lu Xue.

Yan Luo also had an ugly face.

"Class Chief Guan, she is not a foreign tribe, she has the bloodline of my Bingfeng tribe."

Hearing this, everyone present was stunned.

"You, what did you say?"

The Fire Phoenix Clan Chief said in a bit unbelievable.

"I said, she has the bloodline of my Bingfeng clan, not a foreign clan."

Yan Luo said word by word.

Hearing this, the Fire Phoenix Clan Chief immediately understood, and his expression was a little ugly when he looked at Lu Xue.

This person has a close relationship with the woman back then.

"Rules are rules. She is a human race and should not appear in my phoenix race."

At this moment, the Fire Phoenix Clan Chief seemed a little persistent about expelling Lu Xue, because it was related to his majesty.

Seeing that the Fire Phoenix Clan leader was like this, Yan Luo looked up at the void.

"Captain Han, she has the bloodline of my Bingfeng Clan. Do you really turn a blind eye to it?"

As soon as he finished speaking, a sigh suddenly came from the void.

The next moment, a middle-aged man filled with cold air appeared in the field.

凤族，分为冰凤与火凤。

Therefore, the Phoenix Clan also has two clan leaders. Once any Phoenix Clan is in trouble, the other clan will never sit idly by.

而眼前这中年男子，便是冰凤一族的族长。

此刻，冰凤族长看向陆雪的神色，也是有些惋惜。

但，凤族内不能有外族的规定，是很久以前便是传下来的。

当年颜珞的父亲颜凤天带回一位人族女子，颜凤天身份不低，他们可以睁一只眼闭一只眼，但事情闹大后，不行就是不行。

现在，依旧如此。

“颜珞，你不应该带她回来的。”

冰凤族长犹豫后，最终开口道。

Suddenly, the Fire Phoenix Clan leader also breathed a sigh of relief.

如果冰凤族长要保那人族女子，他还真没有办法。

毕竟说到底，那是他们冰凤一族的事。

When Yan Luo heard this answer, she looked ugly.

身后，陆雪拉了拉颜珞的手臂，轻声道：“小姨，要不，我还是走吧。”

Hearing this, Yan Luo suddenly felt extremely heartbroken.

但这时，颜珞似是想到了什么，随即直接将手按到了陆雪的肩膀处。

The next moment, the Bingfeng blood in Lu Xue's body was immediately activated.

A huge ice phoenix vision surged out from Lu Xue's body.

The powerful blood pressure continues to leak out.

The entire snow-capped mountain began to shake.

"The Bing Phoenix Bloodline is perfectly awakened! This, this will actually appear in a human race!"

Seeing this scene, the Bingfeng Clan Chief was shocked.

At this moment, he had to make a new decision on Lu Xue's stay or stay.

Feeling the pressure of blood that was not inferior to him at all, the Bingfeng Clan Chief looked solemn.

Such a genius, with a little training, his Phoenix Clan will have another peerless strongman.

Seeing the Bingfeng Clan Chief's choice look, the Firefeng Clan Chief gritted his teeth.

All the people around were amazed by the Feng tribe.

However, this is not over yet, and another unique breath gushed out from Lu Xue's body.

In an instant, everything around him was covered with a layer of frost, and the Fire Phoenix tribe members were even more seriously injured and kept retreating.

The Huofeng Clan Chief's face suddenly changed, and his flames were burning, which blocked the cold air.

"Ji, Jidao Ice Spirit Body."

The leader of the Bingfeng clan murmured, his eyes full of disbelief.

Not only do they have the blood of the Ice Phoenix, but they also have the extremely rare constitution of the Extreme Ice Spirit Body, and the two complement each other.

This can no longer be described as a genius.

"This woman is from my Bingfeng clan!"

The leader of the Bingfeng tribe immediately shouted.
